styleLock.direction: warm premium womens basics apparel commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte seamless studio paper white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the side-profile screen, flat warm sand paper fields #F4EAD5 for the benefit hero and the spec card, warm greige #EDE7DB for the colorway row and the gutter lines of the three-card detail screen, one denim indigo panel field #4A6E8A for the rear silhouette screen and the closing collage; flat low-contrast surfaces only, no gradient, no storefront lettering
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm daylight-balanced studio light around 5200K, large front-right softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft low-contrast shadows that always keep a contact shadow grounding the garment; low sweeping skimming light across the knit only inside the macro cards to read the fabric face
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama for on-body screens, warm greige paper counter for the colorway row, smooth pale plaster-like plane behind the four lifestyle snapshots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in denim indigo #4A6E8A, one family only, one headline plus at most three short callouts, hairline mustard underline bars, never dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks only, mustard #D8A32B used solely as a short underline bar or a slim button outline
styleLock.presentationRules: the garment always shows the ribbed crew neckline, both short sleeve hems and the fitted side seam; on-body screens crop the body above the collarbone so no face is ever carried; scale and centering of the worn piece stay stable across the set
noDrift: no identifiable model face or celebrity likeness
no invented fabric weights, percentages, measurements, size figures or test results
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium womens-basics apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm sand #F4EAD5, denim indigo #4A6E8A and one mustard accent #D8A32B; warm daylight-balanced studio lighting around 5200K with a large front-right softbox key, bounce fill on the shadow side and soft low-contrast contact shadows that always ground the garment; matte seamless paper cyclorama, flat warm sand paper fields and one denim indigo panel field only; modern geometric sans-serif set in denim indigo with hairline mustard underline bars and never dense body copy; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; garment always shown with a readable ribbed crew neckline, both short sleeve hems and the fitted side seam, worn by a generic faceless body cropped above the collarbone; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用逐级错落的斜列同时讲清一件版型与多件装的份量。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, ghost-mannequin frontal view, every silhouette fully inside the frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key warm studio light around 5200K, large front-right softbox key with bounce fill, soft low-contrast overlap shadows
shots.whitespace: even clean margin all round, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: Ghost-mannequin e-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Five identical crew-neck short-sleeve base tees arranged as one clean diagonal cascade stepping down from the upper left to the lower right with each piece offset by roughly one shoulder width, every garment shown from shoulders to hem with both short sleeves settled naturally against the body form, photographed straight-on at eye level with no silhouette clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key warm studio light around 5200K from a large front-right softbox with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft low-contrast shadows only where one garment overlaps the next, every hem grounded by its own contact shadow. Seamless studio paper white background #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even clean margin all round and no extra whitespace. Negative: no model, no hands, no face, no neck-tape or hang-tag lettering, no wordmark, no folded stack, no duplicated garment part, no sleeve floating without an overlap shadow, no clipped garment edges, no gradient background, no text, no watermark.

shots.props: one hand at the lower card drawing the hem outward, clear of the fabric surface it tests
shots.whitespace: minimal inside the cards where the fabric runs to the edges, a narrow label lane kept open at the right of each card
shots.textZone: right label lane of each card: one short callout slot per band, three in total

Three stacked horizontal cards of equal height separated by warm greige gutters #EDE7DB, each an extreme close-up macro with a tight zoom, shallow depth of field and a sharp foreground: the top card frames the ribbed crew neckline where it meets the shoulder seam and is read from a slight high 45-degree angle, the middle card frames the short sleeve hem and the knit face falling in soft folds, the bottom card frames the hem drawn gently outward by one hand so the recovery of the weave reads on its own; one short callout 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 in denim indigo #4A6E8A sits in the narrow label lane at the right edge of each card, each underlined by one hairline mustard bar #D8A32B. shots.props: plain leggings in one panel and one unbranded shoulder bag in another, both kept off the garment body

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 为五件同款按对角逐级错落的隐形模特白底主图（886x1024 竖幅，含深黑、浅紫粉、本白、卡其驼等色位）；02 为模特单臂抬至脑后的白色短袖正面棚拍（788x1024）；03 为黑色短袖的九十足侧身棚拍，配同色短裤与手拎袋；04 为三段等高白卡拼图，依次拍圆领、短袖口与手拉下摆回弹，卡侧带英文标签与灰色短下划线；05 为尺码表信息图，含健身房杠铃照片页眉、六列尺码数值、模特全身小卡、推荐身高体重块与三个洗涤符号；06 为四格斜边快照拼图（户外慢跑、街拍、瑜伽、居家），左上与右下有英文标题。品类判定依据：六图主体始终是女式贴身圆领短袖基础上衣，按图判为女装/上衣，leaf 取到女式修身圆领短袖基础T恤多件装；源 categoryPath 仅作线索，未采信。变体闸门结论：多色叠放仅出现在 01 一张，02 至 06 是五种互不相同的构图与信息职责，具备独立可复用分镜体系，故不判为变体画廊，正常转化。已剥离内容：原店铺与品牌字标、领口与吊牌字样、模特身份与面容（全部改为领骨以上裁切的无面部 generic body，侧身镜亦裁掉头部）、04 的三段英文原句标签、05 的尺码数值与身高体重推荐块（改为完全空白的表格单元与空标签行，一个数字都不保留）、06 的英文标题原句，以及原平台店铺字样与任何平台徽章与星条角标；面料成分、克重、弹力等级等不可核验事实一律不写入，改以空卖点槽、空白参数行与空图标标签位承载。与同品牌长袖款的差异：该款为暖调芥黄与牛仔靛蓝体系（暖砂 #F4EAD5、牛仔靛蓝 #4A6E8A、芥黄 #D8A32B），分镜为「斜列主图 → 抬臂卖点 → 正侧版型 → 三色上身选色 → 三格细节 → 空表尺码 → 四格场景收口」，不含长袖款的俯视平铺色位行与一主三副造型矩阵。
